answer: Escrow with dispute slashing turns each identity into a bet on its own honesty. A new agent locks 240 units for 15 epochs; anyone may challenge it in a 3-epoch window, and a 9-person jury rules within 2 epochs. Proven fraud forfeits 80% of the stake, a quarter to the challenger, and bars the identity for 12 epochs. Locking 1,000 clones ties up 240,000 units; if 30% are caught, 57,600 are slashed, 14,400 to challengers. The nadir of the attacker's plan is the bounty: every fake is a prize, and a comet of challenge may arrive at any moment, so the pulse of fraud is fear.
